mechanism_narrative: A sustained 20-day decline in FEDFUNDS signals a shift to monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS decline, or the decline does not precede the return increase by at least 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% triggers tight monetary policy, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%, or the return is positive in 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS (easing) and CPIAUCSL (deflationary pressure) lowers real interest rates, enhancing equity value and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL decline concurrently, or the correlation between declines and returns is weak (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (lower unemployment) boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving short-term positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when UNRATE declines, or the decline in UNRATE does not precede the return increase by at least 2 days.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in UNRATE above 5% signals weak labor demand, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative when UNRATE crosses above 5%, or the return is positive in 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO (industrial production) indicates robust supply-side growth, stimulating economic activity and lifting stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when INDPRO rises, or the rise in INDPRO does not precede the return increase by at least 3 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in INDPRO (supply growth) and PAYEMS (employment) signal robust economic expansion, fostering market optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive when both INDPRO and PAYEMS rise concurrently, or the correlation between their rises and returns is weak (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained FEDFUNDS above 4% signals tight monetary policy, leading to market overvaluation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative during periods of FEDFUNDS above 4% in late-cycle expansion, or the return is positive in 70% of such instances.
